Hi Team The 7th sense cafe,

I noticed your cafe has great 4.5★ reviews in Saguna More, Danapur, but currently lacks a dedicated direct-ordering and table reservation website (the web link points to Swiggy).

Maine aapke cafe ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct menu browsing, WhatsApp table booking, aur direct delivery inquiry integrate ki hai:

🔗 https://www.arclanestudios.space/sites/seventhsensecafe

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: "Hi Team The 7th sense cafe, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke cafe ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? Great! Humne ise specifically Saguna More area ke liye direct WhatsApp table booking aur menu showcase ke sath design kiya hai. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga?"
